sample_grid_rep: sample feature values from voxel or triplane grids using trilinear interpolation in a Triton kernel
splat_grid_rep: splat gradient values back into voxel or triplane feature grids using atomic adds in a Triton kernel
review_voxel_grid_sample: review the Triton kernel that performs multi-grid trilinear sampling across voxel and plane grids
review_voxel_grid_splat: review the Triton kernel that splats gradients across multiple voxel and plane feature grids
review_is_in_bounds: review the Triton utility that generates in-bounds masks for normalized 3D coordinates
